description: Count of \(k\le n\) with prime factors dividing \(n\)
oeis_name: Number of numbers <= n whose set of prime factors is a subset of the set of prime factors of n.

description: Denominator of the sum of reciprocals of divisors of \(n\)
oeis_name: Denominator of sum of reciprocals of divisors of n.
For even n, a(n+2) is the greatest integer such that a(n+2)/a(n+1) < a(n+1)/a(n); for odd n, the least integer such that a(n+2)/a(n+1) > a(n+1)/a(n); a(0) = 4, a(1) = 16.
a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} (k^2 mod n).

description: Smallest integer whose Euler totient is divisible by \(2^n\)
oeis_name: Smallest number whose Euler totient is divisible by 2^n.

description: Least multiple of n with n-divisible reversal; 0 if none
oeis_name: First multiple of n whose reverse is also divisible by n, or 0 if no such multiple exists.

description: Factorial-scaled Möbius transform of the harmonic numbers
oeis_name: Sum_{k|n} a(k)/k! = Sum_{j=1 to n} 1/j, sum on left is over positive divisors k of n.
a(n) = sigma_2(n) + phi(n) * sigma(n) - 2*n^2, which is A072779(n) - 2*n^2.

Corresponds to m = 8 in a family of 4th-order linear recurrence sequences given by a(m,n) = m^4*a(n-4) + (2*m)^2*a(n-3) - 4*a(m-1), a(m,0) = -1, a(m,1) = 4, a(m,2) = -13 + 6*(m-1) + 3*(m-1)^2, a(m,3) = (-8+m^2)^2.

description: Least k such that cyclotomic polynomial \(\Phi_k(n)\) is prime
oeis_name: Least k such that Phi(k,n), the k-th cyclotomic polynomial evaluated at n, is prime.

description: Square of the n-th primorial, plus one
oeis_name: a(n) = prime(n)#^2 + 1, where prime(n)# is the n-th primorial (A002110).
Number of ways to write n = p+q(3-(-1)^n)/2 with p>q and p, q, p-6, q+6 all prime.

description: Determinants of Legendre-symbol matrices associated with the \(n\)-th prime
oeis_name: Determinant of the (p_n-1)/2-by-(p_n-1)/2 matrix with (i,j)-entry being the Legendre symbol ((i^2-((p_n-1)/2)!*j)/p_n), where p_n is the n-th prime.

description: Representations \(n=x+y\) with \(6x-1\) Sophie Germain and \(6y\pm1\) twin primes
oeis_name: Number of ways to write n = x + y (x, y > 0) such that 6*x-1 is a Sophie Germain prime and {6*y-1, 6*y+1} is a twin prime pair.

description: Alternating sums of fourth powers of binomial coefficients
Determinants of matrices indicating primality of \(n+i-j\) and \(n-i+j\)
oeis_name: Determinant of the n X n matrix with (i,j)-entry (i,j = 0,...,n-1) equal to 1 or 0 according as n + i - j and n - i + j are both prime or not.
Number of ways to write n = x + y + z with 0 < x <= y <= z such that all the six numbers 2*x-1, 2*y-1, 2*z-1, 2*x*y-1, 2*x*z-1, 2*y*z-1 are prime.

description: Least \(m\): \(\{2^k-k:1\le k\le m\}\) covers residues mod \(n\).
oeis_name: Least positive integer m such that {2^k - k: k = 1,...,m} contains a complete system of residues modulo n.

description: Number of \(1\le k<n\) with equal adjacent interval prime counts
oeis_name: a(n) = |{0 < k < n: the two intervals (k*n, (k+1)*n) and ((k+1)*n, (k+2)*n) contain the same number of primes}|.

description: Ordered nonnegative four-square representations with \(3x^2+4y^2+9z^2\) square
oeis_name: Number of ordered ways to write n as w^2 + x^2 + y^2 + z^2  with 3*x^2 + 4*y^2 + 9*z^2 a square, where w, x, y and z are nonnegative integers.
a(n) is the smallest k different from n such that (n, k) is a Harshad amicable pair (see the comments).
Number of ways to write n as x^2 + 2*y^2 + 3*z^3 + 4*w^4 with x,y,z,w nonnegative integers.

description: Sum of deficiencies of the divisors of \(n\)
oeis_name: Sum of deficiencies of divisors of n.

description: Stabilization time of rightward floor-halving automaton from mass \(n\)
oeis_name: a(n) is the number of steps needed to reach a stable configuration in the 1D cellular automaton initialized with one cell with mass n and based on the rule "each cell gives half of its mass, rounded down, to its right neighbor".

description: Degree-\(n\) Taylor sum of Catalan’s generating function raised to \(4n\)
oeis_name: a(n) = the n-th order Taylor polynomial (centered at 0) of c(x)^(4*n) evaluated at x = 1, where c(x) = (1 - sqrt(1 - 4*x))/(2*x) is the o.g.f. of the sequence of Catalan numbers A000108.
a(n) = n / gcd(n, 1+A018804(n)), where A018804(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} gcd(k, n).

description: Row sums of triangular array A340880
oeis_name: Row sums of A340880.
Start with 2*n-1; repeatedly triple and add 2 until reaching a prime. a(n) = number of steps until reaching a prime > 2*n-1, or 0 if no prime is ever reached.
a(n) = binomial(3*n,n)^2 - 27*binomial(2*n,n).
a(n) = ( Sum_{k = 0..2*n} binomial(n+k-1,k) )^4 * ( Sum_{k = 0..2*n} binomial(n+k-1,k)^2 )^3.
a(n) = (1/n) * Sum_{k = 0..n} (n+2*k) * binomial(n+k-1,k)^3.
Denominator of the continued fraction 1/(2-3/(3-4/(4-5/(...(n-1)-n/(-4))))).

description: Numbers whose prime divisors all end in the same digit.
oeis_name: Numbers whose prime divisors all end in the same digit.

description: Row sums of the irregular triangle A381587
oeis_name: Row sums of irregular triangle A381587.

description: Number of occurrences of \(n\) in A049802.
oeis_name: a(n) is the number of occurrences of n in A049802.
